name: copy
description: Represents a copy-to-clipboard or duplicate action. On hover, the two document sheets parallax apart — the front sheet lifts toward the viewer while the back sheet recedes — communicating layered duplication. On press, both sheets compress together.

animation.description: Two paths (front-sheet, back-sheet) separate on hover via opposing transforms: front translates (+1px,+1px) scale(1.05), back translates (-1px,-1px) scale(0.95) opacity(0.3) — 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1). Press collapses both to scale(0.95) — 100ms easeOut. Reverses on hover-leave. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: When used as a clipboard copy button, pair with a visible or sr-only confirmation (e.g. 'Copied!') after the action completes.
